faqs.title: How do I play Hexa Sort?
faqs.body:
• In order to complete a level, you need to place tiles to sort and merge them
  • You have to place similar colored hex tiles next to each other on the board to sort and stack them.
  • Once you have 10 tiles in a stack the stack will merge and pop
  • Each level gives you a new goal to achieve.
  • You must collect the given number of hex tiles to pass the level.
  • Place the same-colored tiles together and watch them stack, sort, and merge satisfyingly. The collected tiles will allow you to color & build a beautiful world after completing each level.

faqs.title: How do the stacks/tiles merge?
faqs.body:
• Once you place a similar colored stack next to each other, the new stack placed by the user will pull the tiles of the similar colored tiles from the previously placed stack.
  • You need to place at least 10 tiles in a stack for it to merge.
  • Even in a 3-chain (bridge) scenario, suppose you have 2 red stacks with an empty slot between them, and you put another red hex stack in that slot, the last placed hex tile on the board will pull the tiles from the stack that is already placed.

faqs.title: What is Streak Rush?
faqs.body: After you complete level 5, you are invited to join the Hexa Blaze Streak. The goal is to complete a certain number of levels without failing and earning rewards for those streaks. Don't worry if you lose your streak, you will not lose your entire progress. You will start from the last checkpoint.

faqs.title: What is the league system?
faqs.body: You can start competing in the Leagues after passing level 5. Continue to progress through the levels to increase your standing on the leaderboard. Keep track of your position at each level completion screen and aim for one of the top positions to get an exciting reward. You will get a reward for moving on to the next League even if you're not in the top three.

faqs.title: Why do my points on the Leaderboard keep decreasing?
faqs.body: In order to maintain your rank, come back and play levels each day. Remember someone in the world is always sorting the hex tiles, so make sure to continue beating them by playing every day.

faqs.title: What is the Race Event?
faqs.body:
What is the Hexa Grand Prix?

  • Hexa Grand Prix is a timed event that happens every Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun
  • You can compete against four other players to complete 5 levels in 2 hours

How to play the Hexa Grand Prix

  • You can join the Hexa Grand Prix after completing level 10
  • Every Monday, Wednesday, Friday, and Sunday you will be shown an invite to join the race
  • By clicking join you will be taken to the race event screen which you can access later from the main menu
  • Be in the top 3 and claim a free reward chest!

faqs.title: Out of Space
faqs.body:
If you are unable to complete a level and run out of spaces on the board, the Out of Space pop up will appear on your screen. You can choose to return to the level and continue playing by using the Play On option.

Play On: Use coins to remove four stacks and continue playing. 

You can also restart the level by using lives.

faqs.title: Winner's Wheel and Super Winner's Wheel
faqs.body:
Complete levels to unlock the Spin Wheel for rewards!

Tap on the icon to view the Winner’s Wheel - here you can see the available rewards, as well as the amount of levels to complete. Once you’ve done this, you’ll unlock a free spin! Your reward is added to your account immediately.

Using the free spin on the Winner’s Wheel will also unlock the Super Winner’s Wheel Offer - this is a separate Spin Wheel that has higher rewards available.

 

Please note that unlocking the Super Winner’s Wheel will not provide a free spin. To be able to spin the Super Winner’s Wheel, you will have to tap on the button and make an in-app purchase.

faqs.title: What is Battle Pass?
faqs.body:
Battle Pass is a limited-timed feature where players can obtain rewards by completing levels and collecting special items. A new theme is released every month for the Battle Pass Event.

  • It will start at the beginning of the month and ends when the month will end.

Requirements: You need to pass Level 14 to see this feature. This is available for both Android and iOS.

In order to unlock extra rewards under Gold Pass, you will need to purchase the pass. 

  • Gold Pass: Unlocks premium rewards and Golden profile picture frame.
  • Ultimate Gold Pass: Unlocks premium rewards, Golden profile picture frame and increases your lives from 5 to 8
    • Note: You will not automatically receive the rewards under Gold Pass upon purchase. You need to complete the required levels in order to claim the rewards.

faqs.title: Sticker Hunt
faqs.body:
Sticker Hunt unlocks once you reach level 71.

  • Play levels to collect stickers and reveal items on the board.
  • Tap on the board to uncover cells and discover sticker pieces.
  • Each item requires up to 3 stickers to be fully revealed.
  • Once an item is complete, it gets added to your sticker page.
  • Completing a page rewards you with exciting in-game gifts.
  • Finish the entire sticker book to unlock a mega reward!

faqs.title: What is Pinata Smash?
faqs.body:
• Piñata Party is a timed in game event that unlocks after completing level 11.
  • Your main goal is to complete levels to break the piñata and earn rewards. For example: If you are on level 12, you need to finish 6 more levels to break the first piñata and earn rewards.
  • It remains active for 24 hours after joining the event. The event appears on Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday. It activates immediately after the Race Event Time expires.
  • If you complete the race event then, the piñata event also appears.

faqs.title: What is the Subscription Offer?
faqs.body:
• The Daily Reward subscription is a special game feature accessible after completing level 15.
  • Duration:It remains active for 30 days from the date of subscription.
  • This offer provides our players with 40 coins per day, making it a 7x value-added purchase.

faqs.title: What is the News Section?
faqs.body: Keep yourself up to date with all the happenings in Hexa Sort with our News Section. Anytime there’s a new announcement related to upcoming events, offers or features, the news icon will appear on the main menu right at the top corner of the Play Button.

faqs.title: Bonus Bank Rewards
faqs.body:
Once you complete the Battle Pass Event by reaching the last checkpoint, your Bonus Bank will show 720 coins. You will be able to collect the coins in your Bonus Bank by completing levels, and once the event ends which is the last day of the month you’ll get to open and claim all the collected coins.

You’ll need to purchase the Gold Pass or the Ultimate Gold Pass to claim the Bonus Bank coins.

faqs.title: Leaderboard
faqs.body:
What is the Leaderboard

  • A leaderboard is a rank system in Hexa Sort, allowing players to compete against each other.
  • Rise through the ranks and win prizes.
  • The Leaderboard is unlocked after you clear level 5.
  • There are two types of Leaderboards:
    • Leagues
    • Global

What are the Leagues

League is a type of timed event that resets every week, from the day that you download and start playing the game.

 

How do Leagues work 

  • Leagues all have a seven-day timer meaning you not only have to play to reach the top but also you have to fight to maintain your position and earn podium prizes!
  • There is a total of 6 Leagues that you can compete in:
    • Bronze
    • Mercury League
    • Golden League
    • Scarlet League
    • Sapphire League
    • Diamond
  • At each level that you clear, you can earn trophies to increase your position in the league leaderboard.
  • There are 3 Zones in the Leaderboard:
    • Promotion Zone will let you be promoted to the next league with a league promotion reward.
    • Persisting Zone will keep you in the same league with no reward.
    • Demotion Zone will demote you to the previous league.
  • Your final rank for a league will be recorded when the league ends
  • The top 3 players on the leaderboard will earn an extra prize!

Global Leaderboard

The Global Leaderboard lets you see how you rank against other players in your country and around the world.

To move up the leaderboard and become a Hall of Famer, clear as many levels as you can within 3 months. Both the global and country leaderboards reset every 3 months.

You can participate in the Global Leaderboard on the 1st of July!

Global

  • Compete with the top 1,000 players worldwide.
  • Gain points by clearing levels to rise through the ranks.

Local

  • Compete with the top 1,000 players in your country.
  • Clear levels to improve your ranking.

Hall of Fame

  • The Hall of Fame displays the top three players globally from the previous quarter.
  • Clear as many levels as possible within 3 months to earn a spot in the Hall of Fame.

faqs.title: Creator Boost
faqs.body:
• Creator boost allows you to support your favorite content creators by using their codes to get specific rewards
  • Each individual code can only be claimed once
  • The Creator Boost can be accessed at the bottom of the shop

faqs.title: What is the Spin Wheel?
faqs.body:
• You can test your luck on the spin wheel for free!
  • The Spin wheel is unlocked after you clear level 5!
  • You can spin the wheel after clearing a specific set of levels to win prizes ranging from 5 coins to the ultimate prize of 100 coins
  • Apart from this, every time that you spin you can also purchase a super spin to win even bigger prizes to add some cheddar to the top!
  • You can find the spin wheel in the main menu

faqs.title: When will I get to use the spin wheel again?
faqs.body:
• You can use the spin wheel again after you clear the required number of levels
  • The required amounts of levels and how many you have completed for the spin wheel are stated on the spin wheel icon.

faqs.title: What is the super winner's wheel?
faqs.body:
• Once you spin the wheel, you can choose to purchase a spin for the super winner wheel.
  • The super spin can only be used and purchased after you spin the winner's wheel!
  • With the super winners wheel you can win even bigger prizes, starting from 250 coins to up to 1000 coins!

faqs.title: Battle pass
faqs.body:
What is the Battle Pass Event?

  • The Battle Pass event is a unique timed event that refreshes every month.
  • Every month there is a new theme, The current theme is Aerial Odyssey
  • The battle pass is unlocked after level 15

How does the Battle Pass Event work?

    • You automatically join a battle pass event once it starts
    • There are two tiers to each battle pass with rewards on completing a certain number of levels
    • The battle pass can be accessed through the main menu once it is unlocked
    • Press on activate to purchase your premium battle pass.
    • Once your premium tier is finished you can unlock your chest for the ultimate coin prize!
    • If you purchase the battle pass on the 28th, the battle pass will only be valid for 2 days, and so on.
    • Even with a free battle pass you can progress through the stages and unlock your premium prizes later by purchasing the Gold or the Ultimate pass!

faqs.title: What is the Difference between the Gold Pass and the Ultimate Gold Pass?
faqs.body:
Gold PassUltimate Gold Pass
Exclusive Rewards✅✅
Golden Picture Frame✅ (Unique)✅ (More bling than the Gold)
8 Lives❌✅

faqs.title: I purchased the Ultimate / Gold Pass but I did not receive it?
faqs.body:
• If you have purchased the ultimate/gold pass and have not received it then follow these steps:
    • Use the Restore Purchases Button found in the settings menu
    • If the Restore Purchases Button doesn't fix the issue, please delete the game from your device settings and reinstall it.
    • In case that does not work either, please contact in-game chat support with the purchase receipts (found in your email) mentioning:
      • Order Number
      • Date
      • Contents of Purchase

faqs.title: Blaze streak
faqs.body:
What is the Hexa Blaze Streak?

  • Hexa Blaze Streak is a timed event that you can join any day of the week
  • The event is unlocked after you clear level 8
  • The Event is started from the moment you tap join
  • The event duration for Hexa Blaze Streak is 3 days i.e 72 hours after you press join

How does Hexa Blaze Streak work?

  • You have to complete levels without failing to maintain a streak.
  • Every time you lose a level you are demoted to the last tier
  • Each tier has a different requirement for how many levels you need to clear without failing
  • At the end of each tier, you can collect rewards, additionally, if you clear 100 levels without failing in 3 days you can collect the grand prize!

faqs.title: What happens if I fail a level?
faqs.body:
• If you fail a level, you will be displayed the level fail pop-up from where you can watch a Rewarded Video to continue again or you could choose to use 100 coins to play on.
  • Once you tap on the Play On button, four spinners will be launched that will free up 4 slots allowing you to continue playing
  • If you choose not to play, you will lose a life and have to play your current level again.

faqs.title: What do I do if I am out of coins?
faqs.body:
• If you are out of coins, you can do the following to get more coins:
    • Complete some of your weekly quests
    • Get 5 coins every hour from the daily quests or watch an RV for some coins. Please note that the ads reset after 12 hours.
    • Purchase coins in the shop

faqs.title: What are coins used for?
faqs.body:
• Coins are the in-game currency for Hexa Sort and can be used for:
    • Purchasing boosters
    • To continue playing if you fail a level
    • Purchasing lives

faqs.title: Lives
faqs.body:
What are Lives?

  • Lives show you the number of attempts you can have to complete a level
  • You lose one life (attempt) each time you fail a level
  • You can see how many lives you have from the heart-shaped icon displayed at the top middle of the home screen
  • You have a maximum of 5 lives available, which are increased to 8 if you buy the Ultimate Gold Pass
  • One life is refilled every 30 minutes

How can I get more lives?

  • You can purchase the Safety Net Offer that contains Infinite Lives allowing you to play as much as you like without worrying about the number of attempts.
  • You can get infinite lives for 30 minutes from the Daily Rewards
  • You can purchase the Ultimate Gold Pass that increases your lives to 8
  • Lives also regenerate automatically every 30 minutes.

faqs.title: Boosters
faqs.body:
• There are three types of boosters, which you can get by spending coins
    • Hammer can clear any stack on the board of your choosing
    • Swap/Replace helps you swap any one stack with another on the board
    • Refresh Booster refreshes the tiles in the tile tray displayed at the bottom of the screen

faqs.title: Piggy Bank
faqs.body:
• The Piggy bank is an In-game feature that saves coins until you are ready to break it (like an actual piggy bank)
  • When you complete a level, 15 coins are added to your piggy bank
  • You can purchase and open the piggy bank at any point in time, however, it is recommended that you open it once you have it maxed out
  • A piggy bank has a limit of 700 coins that it can hold
  • Once a piggy bank is opened it is reset to 0 and you can start recollecting coins again.

faqs.title: Meta Worlds
faqs.body:
• When you're in the main menu you will see different Meta worlds that you can color and collect!
  • Each time you finish a level you will receive several color tiles that you can use to color your meta-worlds
  • Each Meta World has 5-6 elements that you can color
  • To progress through meta worlds, you have to clear a specific number of levels

faqs.title: Mailbox
faqs.body:
• The Mailbox can be found in the settings panel
  • You can stay up to date with the latest news and updates using the mailbox
  • In case you have a dispute and are rewarded by our CS team you can claim your gifts in the Mailbox.

faqs.title: Daily Rewards
faqs.body:
• You can collect free coins every hour using the daily rewards sections
  • The daily rewards section can be found in the main menu
  • You can also claim additional rewards every 12 hours by watching ads

faqs.title: What is the Weekly Quest?
faqs.body:
What is the Weekly Quest?

  •  A weekly quest is a timed event that resets every Monday and can be accessed from your home screen.
  • You will be presented with a set of 6 tasks that you need to complete within the week
  • Upon Completion of Each Task, you can claim a reward of a specific number of coins

faqs.title: How do I use Play On the Weekly Quest?
faqs.body:
• Play on is a feature that gives you a second chance to replay the level
  • If you fail a level, you can use the play on button to replay the level
  • Upon using the play on button 4 spinners are launched which break random tiles allowing you to keep playing
  • You can use 200 coins to use the play on button.
  • Every time you fail a level, the coins required to play on increases by 100

faqs.title: How do I merge 3 stacks at the same time in the weekly quest?
faqs.body:
• For this task, you need to place your tiles in such a way that three stacks merge and disappear off the board.
  • The stacks do not have to be in the same place and can be merged anywhere on the board, the only prerequisite is that you need to clear 3 or more stacks at the same time of any colour.

faqs.title: Treasure Quest
faqs.body:
What is Treasure Quest?

  • Treasure Quest is a timed event lasting for one day
  • The event is unlocked at level 50
  • 100 users are added into a randomly generated pool
  • The only goal is clearing 7 levels without failing in a set time period to attain the ending reward

How to play treasure quest?

  • The event starts once you receive an invite and you join
  • Treasure Quest lasts for 1 day
  • 100 users have to clear 7 levels without failing.
  • If at any point you fail a level you lose the event
  • Event rewards are divided between all the users that clear all 7 levels.

faqs.title: What is Donut Craze?
faqs.body:
• Donut Craze is a timed event that starts every Thursday and lasts until Sunday.
  • Players can join and start playing anytime during the event.
  • The event unlocks after completing level 39.

faqs.title: How to play Donut Craze
faqs.body:
• Collect donuts by playing levels during the event.
  • Use the collected donuts to complete orders by figuring out the exact sequence of donuts for each order.
  • Every time you complete an order, you will receive rewards!
  • You can complete up to 8 orders, with each order becoming more challenging as more donuts are added.
  • Any leftover donuts after completing all orders will be converted into extra rewards.

faqs.title: What is Arrow Hunt?
faqs.body:
• Arrow Hunt is a limited time event where you will compete in a pool of 50 players
  • The player pool is selected randomly
  • Arrow Hunt is available when you reach level 30
  • Arrow Hunt is available every Friday, Saturday and Sunday
  • The Arrow Hunt lasts for one day (24 hours)

faqs.title: How to Play Arrow Hunt?
faqs.body:
• During the event you will collect targets by beating levels
  • Your rank will be determined by the number of targets you have collected
  • The amount of targets collected by you can be maximized by beating levels without failing.
  • If you fail a level your multiplier will reset
  • When the event is completed, you will receive rewards based on your rank
  • Each Arrow Hunt is a separate even and you cannot transfer your targets to the next event.

faqs.title: How do I connect my game to my Facebook Account?
faqs.body: The feature is currently in-active and under development. Shall be implemented soon.

faqs.title: How do I save my Progress?
faqs.body:
If you are on App Version 4.3.02 or above, you can sync your progress online and play across devices.

  • Go to Settings → Account
  • Choose Facebook, Google, or Apple to sync your account
  • Once linked, you can log in with the same provider on any device to continue where you left off

Your progress is always saved locally on your device as well, but syncing makes sure it is backed up and available on other devices.

Note: If you are on a version below 4.3.02, your progress will only be saved locally and cannot be transferred to another device.

faqs.title: How do I find my user ID?
faqs.body:
You can find your User ID by following these simple steps:

1-Head to the main menu of the game

2-Tap on the settings icon at the top right corner of the screen

3-Your User ID will be at the bottom of the settings panel. You'll see a small "copy" icon next to the User ID, tap on it to copy your ID automatically.

faqs.title: How do I change my name from “User###” to whatever?
faqs.body:
• You can change your username by pressing on your avatar found in the main menu
  • A username doesn't have to be unique and you can set it as anything you like!
  • Make sure you don't use any offensive words in your username

faqs.title: How do I change language in the game?
faqs.body:
You can easily select the language of your choice within the game.

Step 01 - Navigate to the settings panel found in the top right corner of the main menu.

Step 02 - Tap on the Select Language Button

Step 03 - Select your desired language from the available languages.

faqs.title: I want to play from scratch, how do I delete my progress?
faqs.body:
• If you want to play from scratch, you can delete your account from the settings panel and reopen the game again to restart your game
  • Please remember that once your account is deleted you cannot recover your progress

faqs.title: What does a delete account do?
faqs.body:
• Delete account, deletes your account permanently.
  • Once used the account can never be recovered and if you open HexaSort you would have to start from scratch.

faqs.title: How do I change my avatar?
faqs.body:
• You can change your avatar by pressing on the avatar found in the main menu
  • You can select from 12 different avatars, some of whom are unlocked when you complete a specific set of levels

faqs.title: How do I transfer my Progress to another device?
faqs.body:
Account syncing is now available for app version 4.3.02 and above.

 

Creating a Save

  • To create your save, please access your Settings Menu (the gear icon at the top right), select "Save Progress" and select either Facebook\Apple or Facebook\Google (depending on your device you are logged into).

 

Transferring the progress to a new device

  • On your old device, open the game and go to Settings → Account.
      • Sync your progress with Facebook, Google, or Apple.
    1. On your new device, install and open the game.
      • Go to Settings → Account and log in with the same provider you used on the old device.

    Note: If you haven’t synced your account with Facebook, Google, or Apple, your progress will only be stored locally and cannot be transferred to another device.

faqs.title: How do I recover my account?
faqs.body:
• For version 1.6.50 you can save your progress locally on a device
  • This is only possible if you have deleted the game but not your account
  • Make sure your internet is connected so that the account can be recovered locally
  • Simply Reinstall the game on the same device to recover your account

To Recover your account on a new device

  1. On your old device, open the game and go to Settings → Account.
    • Sync your progress with Facebook, Google, or Apple.
  2. On your new device, install and open the game.
    • Go to Settings → Account and log in with the same provider you used on the old device.

faqs.title: How do I cancel my accidental purchase?
faqs.body:
Android: If you are an Android user, kindly send us a screenshot of your Google Purchase Receipt. This will enable us to promptly investigate and process a refund.

iOS: If you are playing our game on an Apple device, please be informed that we are unable to process refunds directly, as the Apple Store manages all transactions. In this event, we kindly ask you to reach out to Apple Support for assistance in initiating the refund process.

To prevent unintentional or unauthorized future purchases, we recommend visiting the following links to learn how to set restrictions on your device:

  • Android
  • iOS

Implementing these restrictions add an extra layer of security and control over your in-app purchases, ensuring a more secure and enjoyable gaming experience.

We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in this matter. If you have any further questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to our support team.

faqs.title: I purchased a bundle/coins but didn't get them!
faqs.body:
Please send us your User ID (found in the settings panel of the game) and include a screenshot of your purchase confirmation/receipt

We'll do our best to credit it to your account!

faqs.title: 1+1 Offer
faqs.body:
• 1+1 Offer is an in-app purchase that allows you to purchase coins and boosters
  • There are two kinds of rewards in a 1+1 Offer
  • If you buy the offer you get the other rewards for free
  • Each Month has a different theme for the 1+1 offer
  • You can find this on the main menu screen

faqs.title: Chain Offer
faqs.body:
• Chain offer is an in-app purchase which allows you purchase coins and boosters
  • The chain offer allows you to earn rewards just by playing the game
  • There are two types of offers
    • Two Free Offers
    • One Paid Offer
  • The rewards are in a sequence with a total of three rewards visible on the screen at a time.
  • Both the Free Offers can be unlocked at first whereas the Paid offer is unlocked last and can only be purchased once both the other offers have been unlocked.

faqs.title: Starter Pack
faqs.body:
• Starter Pack is an in-app purchase that allows you to purchase coins and boosters
  • Starter Pack allows you to kickstart your sorting journey by giving you some essentials for the way
  • This bundle is only offered once to each user for a limited amount of time.

faqs.title: Coin Pack
faqs.body:
• Coin pack is an in-app purchase that allows you purchase coins.
  • Coin Packs can be found in the shop at any time during your gameplay
  • There are 6 different coin packs with varying amounts of coins in each one of them

faqs.title: Safety Net Offer
faqs.body: The Safety Net offer is a limited-time deal available after the user fails a level. It can only be purchased once every 2 hours.

faqs.title: What is the HexaSort Official Store?
faqs.body:
What is the HexaSort Official Store?

  • The HexaSort Official Store is a new way to buy coins, bundles, and offers directly inside the game.
  • It is powered by AppCharge, a secure web-based checkout, instead of the App Store or Google Play.
  • Buying through the Official Store unlocks better deals, including up to 10% off on eligible items.

What is Buy Direct?

  • Buy Direct is a toggle that lets you choose where your in-game purchases are processed.
  • When ON, your purchases go through the HexaSort Official Store (AppCharge).
  • When OFF, your purchases go through the regular App Store / Google Play flow.
  • The toggle is always optional — you can switch back at any time.

Where do I find the Buy Direct toggle?

  • You can switch Buy Direct on or off from two places:
    • Settings menu → look for BUY DIRECT alongside Sounds, Notifications, Haptics, Game Boost, etc.
    • The Switch to AppCharge pop-up that appears when you are in the shop
  • Tap GOT IT! on the pop-up to apply your choice.

How do I make a purchase through the Official Store?

  • Tap any offer in the Shop while Buy Direct is ON (or pick the Official Store option from the Switch to AppCharge pop-up).
  • You will be taken to the AppCharge checkout page, which shows:
    • The item name and price
    • Your email
    • Your saved payment methods (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) or google pay/apple pay
  • Tap Pay to complete your purchase.
  • Once payment is processed, tap Return to game to head back to HexaSort with your reward delivered!

Is paying through the Official Store safe?

  • Yes! AppCharge is a secure third-party payment processor that handles your card information.
  • HexaSort does not see or store your payment details.
  • You can find AppCharge's Privacy Policy, Refund Policy, and Support links at the bottom of the checkout page.

I bought something through the Official Store but did not receive it?

  • If your purchase was completed but you have not received your reward, follow these steps:
    • Tap on the Restore Purchases button found in the Settings menu.
    • If the Restore Purchases button does not fix the issue, please delete the game and reinstall it (without deleting your account).
    • In case that does not work either, please contact in-game chat support with the purchase receipt (found in your email) mentioning:
      • Order Number
      • Date
      • Contents of Purchase

    • The item name and price
    • Your email
    • Your saved payment methods (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) or google pay/apple pay
  • Tap Pay to complete your purchase.
  • Once payment is processed, tap Return to game to head back to HexaSort with your reward delivered!

Is paying through the Official Store safe?

  • Yes! AppCharge is a secure third-party payment processor that handles your card information.
  • HexaSort does not see or store your payment details.
  • You can find AppCharge's Privacy Policy, Refund Policy, and Support links at the bottom of the checkout page.

I bought something through the Official Store but did not receive it?

  • If your purchase was completed but you have not received your reward, follow these steps:
    • Tap on the Restore Purchases button found in the Settings menu.
    • If the Restore Purchases button does not fix the issue, please delete the game and reinstall it (without deleting your account).
      • Disclaimer: Please connect your account to Facebook/google and apple before deleting your account
    • In case that does not work either, please contact in-game chat support with the purchase receipt (found in your email) mentioning:
      • Order Number
      • Date
      • Contents of Purchase

Why don't I see the Buy Direct toggle?

  • The Buy Direct toggle is currently available to select iOS and Android users in the US on App Version 5.4.10 and Above
  • This feature will be released soon to all users in the US
  • Please keep an eye out here for updates on availability!

faqs.title: I'm Colorblind and have difficulty sorting the colors.
faqs.body:
You can play our colorblind mode that's designed to ease the color difficulty. Please follow these simple steps:

1- Head to the main menu of the game.

2- Tap on the settings icon at the top right corner of the screen.

3- In the settings panel, you will see the colorblind toggle button, turn it on.

faqs.title: Can I Remove Ads/No Ads in the game?
faqs.body:
It's possible to disable full screen ad interruptions during gameplay (also known as interstitial ads) with a No Ads item! If you haven't purchased this item in the past, you can purchase this consumable item to disable interstitial ads for 30 days. If your time runs out, you can purchase the item again to disable interstitial ads for another 30 days.

Please note that banner ads and rewarded videos cannot be removed. You will always have the option to watch advertisements to receive extra rewards!

The Remove-Ads can be found in your main menu screen and the Remove Ads bundle in the store. 


 

Update:

  • Before Version 2.0.58 - No Ads is permanent
  • Version 2.0.58 - Before Version 4.8.30 - No Ads is a 30 days consumable
  • Version 4.8.30 - Present - No Ads is permanent

 

Notice:

  • Purchased permanent No Ads would remain intact even with updates.
  • Purchased 30 days No Ads would not transition to a permanent No Ads when changes occur.

faqs.title: I have to quit my game, why do the ads show a black screen?
faqs.body:
We are currently trying to identify the advertisers that are causing this issue in our app.

You can help us report this promptly by taking a screenshot of the ad once the store link/app name appears on the screen. This effort of yours can help us identify and immediately report the advertiser and have it permanently blocked from the game.

faqs.title: I keep getting inappropriate ads, how do I report AD?
faqs.body:
We are actively working to ban such advertisers from our game. Here’s how you can help us speed up this process and ensure more player-friendly ads. When a distasteful ad appears:

1.  Take a screenshot of the AD that you want to report
2.  While an ad is playing, flip your device screen down twice
3.  A logo will appear on the right side of the screen
4.  Press on the logo to open the ads screen and identify the ad format that just played along with how long the ad played.
5.  When you press on the ad you want to report you can press share and copy it and send it to us using the in-game chat support

The visual identification helps us promptly identify the advertiser and block them permanently without any delay.

faqs.title: I am unable to close an Ad
faqs.body:
• You can skip interstitial ads only however you cannot skip rewarded ads.
  • In case an ad has a fake cross, kindly follow the process to report ads and take a screenshot to us so that we can promptly look into them and block such advertisers.
  • Banner ads cannot be closed as they are always present at the bottom of your screen. You can remove them by purchasing the No-Ads IAP.

faqs.title: I purchased No-Ads but I am still getting ads
faqs.body:
• If you are still getting ads even after purchasing no-ads try these steps:

    1. Tap on the Restore Purchases Button
    2. Close and Restart your App
      • Make sure you are connected to the internet
    3. Delete and Reinstall your app without deleting your account

    If none of these fix the issue, please send us a purchase receipt using the in-game chat support, and let us handle it for you. Please make sure the receipt mentions the order number and other details about your purchase.

faqs.title: Game Freezing / Crashing / Not Loading
faqs.body:
If you’re experiencing issues while playing, please try the following troubleshooting steps:

  • Ensure the game is up to date - Make sure you’re running the latest version
  • Clear your cache - Clearing cached data can help fix loading, freezing, or performance issues.
  • Restart your device - Rebooting your device helps refresh system processes and can resolve temporary issues affecting gameplay.
  • Check your connection - Make sure you’re connected to a strong Wi-Fi or mobile data signal. Try switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data to see if the issue improves.
If you are still running into problems or still require assistance after doing this, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. We'll be happy to investigate further and assist.

faqs.title: What is a Collection?
faqs.body:
Collections are a special, time-limited feature where you can gather cards through chests and events.

  • You'll unlock the Collections feature after completing level 71.
  • Each collection lasts for two months, giving you plenty of time to collect and enjoy!
  • You can access collections by pressing on the cards icon on the bottom right.

faqs.title: What are Cards?
faqs.body:
• Cards are the core building blocks of a collection.
  • You can find these cards in card packs, which you can earn or unlock.
  • There are two different type of cards
    • Normal Cards
    • Golden Cards
  • Golden Cards give you double stars when duplicated and are also very rare to find whereas Normal Cards are common
  • Each card belongs to a specific set within the collection.
  • When starting a new collection you will receive a pack of four cards to start with.
  • Cards have a 1-5 star rating, with higher-rated cards being rarer and harder to obtain—so getting those special ones feels extra rewarding!

faqs.title: What happens to my duplicate cards?
faqs.body:
• Don’t worry about duplicates! They are automatically converted into stars, which can be used to open more chests and expand your collection.
    - The number of stars you earn from duplicates is based on the card's rating.
    - On collecting a duplicate golden card, your stars are doubled.

faqs.title: What are Card Packs?
faqs.body:
• Card Packs are available through events and tournaments, and they’re your gateway to new cards.
  • When you open a pack, you’ll receive a random set of cards—some may be duplicates, but that’s a great way to collect stars!
  • When starting a new collection you receive a single pack of four cards to begin with!
  • Each pack contains anywhere from 2 to 6 cards, so there's always something exciting to look forward to.

faqs.title: What are Sets?
faqs.body:
• Sets are made up of multiple cards that share a specific theme.
    - Each set has a unique theme and specific cards that a set needs.
    - Completing sets will help you complete an entire collection!

faqs.title: What happens if I complete a collection/set?
faqs.body:
- Completing a set rewards you with a special prize tied to that set.
- When you finish an entire collection, you’ll unlock a chest filled with amazing rewards and receive a unique badge that will appear on your profile to show off your achievement!

faqs.title: What happens when a collection ends?
faqs.body: Once a collection ends, all your stars and unclaimed cards will be reset. But don’t worry—any badges you earned will stay with you as a reminder of your accomplishments!

faqs.title: What is a Mystery Card?
faqs.body:
• Mystery Cards are special, event-exclusive cards you can only earn by winning certain events (e.g., Piñata Smash, Weekly Quest, Donut Craze, Sticker Hunt).
  • To collect them, join, play, and win the eligible event—rewards are granted on victory.
  • Mystery Cards do not drop from card packs or regular gameplay; they’re event-only.
  • Every Mystery Card is a 5-star, Ultra Rare card.

faqs.title: Why did I not receive the Mystery Card from the Pinata event?
faqs.body:
You would need to break open the 3rd Pinata for you to receive the Mystery Card  from the Pinata event

  • Breaking the 1st Pinata provides 3 cards (No mystery cards)

  • Breaking the 2nd Pinata provides 4 cards (No mystery cards)

  • Breaking the 3rd Pinata (Final pinata) provides 6 cards (Including 1 mystery card)

faqs.title: What is a Popcorn Tile?
faqs.body:
• Popcorn is a special tile type unlocked at level 1111.
  • The goal is to create popcorn by merging tiles next to the popcorn machine and then collect all the popcorn boxes.
  • The popcorn machine displays the number of tiles required to create the popcorn.
  • Once the required number of tiles is merged, the popcorn machine disappears and 3 random popcorn boxes are placed on the board.
  • You can merge tiles anywhere on the board to create the popcorn.
  • After the popcorn is created, merge next to a popcorn box to collect it.

faqs.title: What are Mole Tiles?
faqs.body:
Mole is a special tile type unlocked at level 963.

  • The goal is to collect all the moles from mole hills on the board.
  • A mole can pop out of any mole hill.
  • Merge a stack next to a mole hill to collect the mole.
  • You can merge next to any part of a mole hill to collect it.
  • Each mole hill contains one mole that must be collected to clear it.

faqs.title: What are Locked Slots?
faqs.body:
• You will have to merge hex tiles to free up these slots.
  • Once you have reached the required score goal the lock slot will be free.

faqs.title: What are Locked Stack Tile?
faqs.body:
• You will have to merge the hex tiles to unlock the locked stack.
  • After reaching the required score goal the hex stack will be free.

faqs.title: What is a Jelly Tile?
faqs.body:
Jelly is a special tile type unlocked at level 611.

  • To clear Jelly, you need to merge stacks adjacent to it.
  • Each Jelly tile can have 1, 2, or 3 slices.
  • To collect a Jelly slice, merge a stack next to a slice.
  • Once all the slices are collect the jelly would disappear from the board

faqs.title: What is a Seed Box?
faqs.body:
The Seed box is a special tile type unlocked at level 661.

  • Its purpose is to create and collect all the grass on the board.
  • Each Seed box contains a specific number of seed packets.
  • When you merge a stack adjacent to a Seed box, it opens a seed packet, planting seeds onto a random tile.
  • The seeds turn the selected tile into grass, and the tile is chosen randomly.

faqs.title: What are Curtain Tiles?
faqs.body:
• Curtain is a special tile type that are unlocked at level 211
  • You will have to merge the hex tiles to reveal the curtain
  • After reaching the required score goal the hex stack will be uncovered
  • There could be anything under a curtain tile.

faqs.title: What are Playpen tiles?
faqs.body:
• Playpen is a special tile type that are unlocked at level 241
  • The goal is to collect all the balls from the playpen; once all balls are collected, the playpen tile is removed, freeing up a tile space.
  • To clear a ball from the playpen, you need to merge tiles of the same color as the ball next to the playpen tile, which will clear the balls and eventually the playpen.

faqs.title: What are Wood Tiles?
faqs.body:
Wood tiles are a special tile type that are unlocked after level 40.

  • To break a wood tile, you would need to merge stacks next to it.
  • You would need to merge up to 3 stacks next to a wood tile to break it.

faqs.title: What are Ice Tiles?
faqs.body:
Ice tiles are a special tile type that are unlocked after level 60.

  • To break an Ice tile, you would need to merge a stack next to it.
  • Each ice tile contains a stack that can be freed and used later.
  • You would need to merge 3 stacks next to an Ice tile to break it.

faqs.title: What are Grass Tiles?
faqs.body:
Grass tiles are a special tile type that is unlocked after level 120.

  • To break a grass tile, you would need to merge a stack over it.
  • A green leaf on the top of your stack indicates that the stack is over a grass tile.

faqs.title: What are Camera Tiles
faqs.body:
Camera Tiles are a Special Tile Type that is unlocked after level 90.

  • A Camera tile produces a picture when you merge a tile next to it.

faqs.title: What are Firecracker Tiles?
faqs.body:
Firecracker tiles are a special type of tile that is unlocked after Level 150.

  • A Firecracker tile produces firecrackers when you merge a tile next to it.
  • Each tile has 4 firecrackers in it.

faqs.title: What is a Car Tile?
faqs.body:
A Car tile is a special type of tile that is unlocked after level 181.

  • A car tile is a dynamic tile requiring you to clear all tiles in its path for it to get to the end of the board on the side it is facing.
  • You do not need to merge a stack to clear a car tile, just need to clear its way for it to move.
  • Every time a tile is cleared of a stack the car moves and occupies the next available position in the Stack.

faqs.title: What is a Gem Box Tile?
faqs.body:
The Gem Box is a special tile type that are unlocked after level 271.

  • The objective is to merge stacks adjacent to the box to release gems, then merge adjacent to the gems to collect them.

faqs.title: What is a Waiting Tile?
faqs.body:
• A waiting tile is a special tile type that are unlocked at level 301
  • The objective is to collect a certain number of tiles by merging stacks anywhere to free a waiting tile
  • Once the tile goal is met the tile would be freed and added to the board.

faqs.title: What is a Carpet Tile?
faqs.body:
• A Carpet Tile is a special type of tile that becomes available at level 331.

    - The objective is to collect the Carpet Tile.
    - To do this, merge tiles adjacent to the Carpet Tile to make it roll. Once the Carpet Tile is fully rolled, it will be collected.

faqs.title: What is a Honey Tile?
faqs.body:
• Honey is a special tile type that is unlocked at level 361
    - The goal is to empty the honeypot
    - When a tile is merged next to the honey pot a stack next to it will get some of the honey on it.
    - Merging a stack next to a tile with honey on it would collect the honey.

faqs.title: What is a Pearl Tile?
faqs.body:
• Pearl is a special tile type unlocked at level 391.
  • The goal of the Pearl tile type is to collect all the pearls by merging tiles of the same color next to a clam.
  • Each pearl in a level can have a different color.
  • Once all the pearls are collected, the clamshells close.

faqs.title: What is a Bird's Nest Tile?
faqs.body:
• Bird's Nest is a special tile type unlocked at level 421.
  • The goal of the Bird's Nest is to hatch and then collect birds.
  • When a stack is merged next to a tile a bird is hatched.
  • Merging a tile next to a bird would collect it.

faqs.title: What is a Drone Tile?
faqs.body:
• Drone is a special tile type unlocked at level 451.
  • The objective of a drone tile is to initiate a drop that adds new tiles to the board.
  • When a stack is merged next to a drone, its propellers begin spinning.
  • On the next merge, the drone takes flight and drops a tile onto the board.
  • Once all its tiles are dropped and collected, the drone itself will be collected.

faqs.title: What is a Doll Tile?
faqs.body:
• Dolls are a special tile type that unlocks at level 481.
  • The objective of dolls is to collect the smallest doll.
  • A doll tile has three levels, meaning you need to merge three stacks next to the doll to fully collect it.
  • Every time a stack is merged, the doll opens to reveal a smaller doll inside. This new doll bounces to a random neighbouring tile.

faqs.title: What is a Rainbow Launcher?
faqs.body:
• Rainbow Launcher is a special tile type unlocked at level 511.
    - The goal of the Rainbow Launcher is to activate it and have it merge with a random stack to clear it.
    - The Rainbow Launcher acts as a helpful assistant during gameplay.
    - To activate the Rainbow Launcher, merge a stack next to it.
    - Once activated, the Rainbow Launcher will launch a rainbow when you merge next to it. The rainbow will land on a random stack, helping you clear it.

faqs.title: What is a Color Nuts Tile?
faqs.body:
- Color Nuts is a special tile type unlocked at level 561.
- You have to merge same-colored stacks next to the Color Nuts Tile to collect the nuts and achieve your goal.
- Each Color Nut Bolt contains several different colored nuts.
- To clear a bolt, you must collect all the nuts associated with it.

Pro Tip: You can merge for the nut at the bottom to clear your color nuts in one single move!

faqs.title: What is a Cupboard Tile?
faqs.body:
• Cupboard is a special tile type unlocked at level 711.
  • Merge stacks next to the Cupboard to break it open and reveal the cups inside.
  • Once opened, merge next to the Cupboard again to break a cup.
  • You can merge next to any part of the Cupboard to break the cups.
  • Some Cupboard tiles can span multiple spaces on the board.
  • Each Cupboard contains a set number of cups that must be broken to clear it.

faqs.title: What is a Safe Tile?
faqs.body:
• Safe is a special tile type unlocked at level 761.
  • Merge stacks next to the Safe to unlock it.
  • Each Safe requires 60 tiles to be merged next to it.
  • You can use multiple small stacks or fewer large stacks to reach the total.
  • Once 60 tiles are merged, the Safe will be collected.

faqs.title: What is a Bloom Tile?
faqs.body:
Bloom is a special tile type unlocked at level 861.

  • When you merge a stack next to a Bloom tile, it will sprout with the color of the merged stack.
  • To clear the Bloom tile, you need to merge a stack of the same color next to it.

faqs.title: What is a Toaster Tile?
faqs.body:
Toaster is a special tile type unlocked at level 911.

  • The goal is to collect toast pieces.
  • Merge a stack next to the Toaster to start it.
  • On your next merge, two toast pieces pop out and are collected
  • The Toaster keeps working until you collect the total number of toast pieces shown in the level goal, then it disappears.

faqs.title: What is a Kettle Tile?
faqs.body:
Kettle is a special tile type unlocked at level 961.

  • The goal is to clear smoke clouds.
  • Merge a stack next to the Kettle to release a smoke cloud that covers a random stack.
  • Merge next to the smoked stack to clear the smoke and free that tile.
  • The Kettle keeps releasing smoke until you clear the number of smoke clouds required by the level goal, then it disappears.

faqs.title: What is a Candy tile?
faqs.body:
• Candy is a special tile type unlocked at level 1153.
  • The objective is to collect candy by making merges next to the candy machine.
  • Each time you merge beside the machine, a candy is produced and collected. As the candy is consumed, the machine’s stick shortens, freeing up more space on the board.
  • When the stick is completely used up, the candy machine disappears.

faqs.title: What is a dice tile?
faqs.body:
• Dice is a special tile type unlocked at level 1253
  • Merge stacks next to the Dice to roll it
  • Collect the number shown on the Dice when it rolls
  • Once the required numbers are collected, the Dice will disappear from the board

faqs.title: What is a Drill Tile>
faqs.body:
• Drill is a special tile type unlocked at level 1353.
  • The goal is to use the Drill to collect tiles from the board.
  • Merge a stack next to the Drill to activate it.
  • On the next merge, the Drill will travel to the nearest tile and collect it.
  • If multiple tiles or objects are at the same distance, the Drill will choose one randomly.
  • The Drill remains on the board for the entire level.

faqs.title: What is a Soil tile?
faqs.body:
• Soil is a special tile type that is unlocked at level 1453.
  • The goal of the Soil tile is to clear all connected soil patches from the board.
  • To clear Soil, merge any stack next to a Soil tile.
  • When you break one Soil tile, all other Soil tiles directly connected to it will also break at the same time.
  • Soil tiles only clear in connected groups, so larger clusters of Soil will disappear together once any tile in that group is broken.

faqs.title: What is a Rabbit Tile?
faqs.body:
• The Rabbit is a special tile type unlocked at level 1602.
  • The goal of the Rabbit tile is to collect the carrot.
  • To wake up the Rabbit, merge stacks next to it.
  • Once the Rabbit is awakened, it will reveal a carrot.
  • Merging stacks next to the Rabbit will clear it once the carrot is collected.

faqs.title: What is a Penguin Tile?
faqs.body:
• The Penguin is a special tile type unlocked at level 1753.
  • The goal of the Penguin tile is to clear the path to the igloo, and by freeing the penguin from the ice
  • To melt the ice, merge stacks next to the Penguin.
  • Once the ice is melted, your penguin can move towards the igloo
  • You can move the penguin to the igloo by clearing the tiles in its way
  • The Penguin tile is cleared once the penguin reaches the igloo

faqs.title: What is a Tesla Tile?
faqs.body:
• Tesla is a special tile type unlocked at level 1903.
  • The goal of the Tesla tile is to charge it and light a bulb.
  • To charge the Tesla, merge stacks next to it.
  • After charging the Tesla, merge next to it again to light a bulb.
  • The Tesla tile is cleared once the required bulbs are lit.

faqs.title: What is the Hex Generator tile?
faqs.body:
• Hex Generator is a special tile type unlocked at level 2103.
  • The goal of the Hex Generator is to collect hexa tiles produced by the generator.
  • The Hex Generator releases a hexa tile into the slot directly in front of it.
  • To receive the next hexa tile, clear the slot in front of the Hex Generator by merging a stack on it.
  • Once the slot is cleared, the Hex Generator releases another hexa tile.
  • The Hex Generator keeps producing hexa tiles until the level goal is met.
